grader_note: same-model (glm-5.2), MODE-BLINDED (anonymized /tmp/gN.md; domain known, mode not). NOT human-expert evidence.
biggest_strength: Two-level identifiability honesty (MAR=prior-dominated, MNAR=not-identifiable) carried byte-identically through the chain, turning the beta_dropout diagnostic itself into the novelty locus rather than hiding the assumption.
